notes: DCInside projectcc posts no >= 76000 (76044..77154), dated 2026-09-26..2026-09-28. Cookie identities in formation screenshots are read from the art, not from labels; each team entry says how a cookie was identified. Cross-post elimination (text names vs. screenshots of the same deck) gives: pink hair + red hat = 마카롱; priest in green stole = 피노누아 (confirmed by the in-game stat panel in 76631); red dress = 석류; doctor with pink bear = 우유 (소아과 의사); small green leaf cookie = 허브; black armoured knight = 다크초코 (76798 removes 다크초코 and it disappears); red/black twin-tail girl = 체리콜라 (76798 adds 체콜 and it appears); white-haired girl with blue-flame bow = 바리공주 (absent in 76834 whose author says 바리 is only 3-star); red scorpion-tail hair = 전갈; orange fox-eared girl = 달토끼 (77139 text); wheat-feather hat gunslinger = 호밀; green goggles cookie = 메론소다 (76211 text); orange flower + teal hood = 정글전사 (medium); red-haired man with wine glass = 뱀파이어 (medium); pink/blue jester = 트위즐젤리 (medium); white hair + red greatsword = 오븐방랑자 (medium); purple witch = 위치베리 (medium); orange wizard hat = 마법사 (77139 text). Three recurring cookies are only resolved as the set {브라이트시커, 치즈케이크, 피겨여왕}: light-element archer with heart hat (most likely 브라이트시커, the rear-line ranged dealer), gold-faced water-element support in blue dress with trident (most likely 치즈케이크, the buffer; 76286 has it while a commenter says that deck has no 브시커), and golden fluffy light-element charger (most likely 피겨여왕). These three carry confidence 'low' below. A floating staff sprite seen in 76286/76859-1/77139 is taken to be the trident cookie mid-animation.

posts.title_en: The 35% power line for 328-30 is 4G

A 4G player (oven Lv.36) explains how: gear levels with oven, steady research, Bari 5-star, Stellar 8 with 6 pieces, and a stage preset rolled purely for displayed power. mechanics: Power sources named: oven level (raises gear level), research (largest: '뻥투는 순전히 연구빨'), fame, Stellar Link pieces, cookie stars (Bari 5-star).
Plate +18 is the practical max; +20 gives a big jump but is not feasible.
Daily arena #1 reward (acceleration tickets) speeds research.

posts.title_en: The Rift is just a wait-for-Dimensional-Power meta
posts.summary_en: 카린 (same player as 76835; Rift rank 180th, 축복 Lv.7) cleared Rift 4 폭주단 트럭 (0.000% HP) with displayed team power 8G 46M 895K, up from 4G 3M 599K at Rift entry. Says each 차원의 힘 level-up clears one more Rift level. 나나리: retry; everything but 비겁이 clears.

clears.note: same 12 cookies as 76835 in the battle bar; oven Lv.37; preset 1

rift: Rift 4 boss = 폭주단 트럭.
Displayed power doubled from 4.0G (Rift entry, 차원의 힘 Lv.1) to 8.05G by 차원의 힘 Lv.4 (see 77124).
Each 차원의 힘 level lets you clear roughly one more Rift level (poster); 나나리: with retries everything but 비겁이 clears.

quotes.en: Each time Dimensional Power goes up, I clear one more
Keep retrying, everything but 비겁이 goes down

rift: 차원의 힘 Lv.4 needs 2,040 to level (Lv.1 needed 30).
Rift power rises ~1-2G per 차원의 힘 level (reply).
Stage boss-summon quest does not progress from Rift boss summons.

quotes.en: It goes up 1-2G every level

stage_types: 비겁이: keep the 35% bracket; 15% is not viable.
disagreements: Contrasts with 76779 (claims 비겁이 at 328-30 cleared at 15%, ~3G).

quotes.en: Checked power and it was 15% lol; set it to 35% and cleared first try
